name: Wireless heat and smoke alarms BSI (Ei603TYCRF-CON)
summary: Context Plus Wireless heat detector with built-in sounder, BSI Kitemarked, Powered by 10 year life fixed battery complete with Plug in Radio frequency module with built-in RadioLink transmitter and receiver (868 MHZ signal) , circle shaped with easy twist to fit base – BSI Kitemarked to BS 5446-2:2003
